messages:
anya (prod): Quick sync — need a decision on the 'burst fractionation' idea before roadmap finalization. TL;DR: allow customers to split reserved burst into N smaller bursts to improve utilization. Thoughts?

mike (eng-platform): I like the utilization angle. main risk: complexity in admission + preemption. who owns the policy?

joel (infra): Complexity is mostly in the admission layer. If we keep a simple heuristic (fraction <= 25% of commit, max 3 fragments) we can limit state explosion. still needs new quota bookkeeping.

ravi (sre): ops concern: if fragments preempt independently, oncall noise could spike. need clear visibility and circuit-breaker.

anya (prod): Good point. Proposal: fragments treated as peer-class priority buckets with a shared lease. Preempt from newest fragment first. That keeps predictable evictions.

mike (eng-platform): That works. Two follow ups: (1) autoscale integration — if we prewarm per-fragment, we might lose the benefit of pooled prewarm. (2) billing keeps simple: charge against committed tokens, but show per-fragment usage in console.

sophia (sales): Customers asking for predictable burst for many short-lived sessions (chatbots, call centers). If we support 3 fragments, they can map to region/timezone buckets. This is a strong sales narrative.

joel (infra): Implementation sketch: add Fragment table keyed by (commit_id, fragment_index) with fields: available_tokens, window_start, window_end, preemptable. admission checks aggregate across fragments. Prefill KV cache per fragment only on first activation.

anya (prod): Can you paste a minimal config we would expose to customers?

mike (eng-platform): Sure, rough draft: ```json
{"burst_fragments": 3, "max_fragment_fraction": 0.25, "spill_to_pool": true, "preempt_order": "LIFO"}```

ravi (sre): Also need rollout & canary criteria. Suggest: 2-week canary on internal reserved pool, metric gates: median latency <= SLO+10ms, 99th token latency <= SLO+40ms, preempt rate <= 0.5% of requests, oncall alerts unchanged.

anya (prod): Love it. For launch criteria, add quality guard: no regressions on our eval prompt set + two pilot customers (one chat at scale, one enterprise batch) signed off.

sophia (sales): We already have one pilot prospect willing to try if we can guarantee max 3 fragments and region affinity. I can lock them in if we make the pilot quick (2-3 sprints).

mike (eng-platform): Engineering estimate: infra + quota + console UI + metrics ~ 3 sprints (6 weeks) for MVP with 3 fragments and fixed policies. Extra 1 sprint for autoscale tweaks and spill-to-pool integration.

joel (infra): Risk log: (1) bookkeeping scale with many small commits, (2) unexpected preemption cascades, (3) telemetry gaps for per-fragment KPIs. Mitigations: cap fragments per account, circuit-breaker on preempt rate, perf test harness.

ravi (sre): Add ops playbook entry: how to force-collapse fragments (admin endpoint) to recover noisy tenants.

anya (prod): Decision check: are we OK to take MVP: 3 fragments, LIFO preempt, spill-to-pool true, show per-fragment usage in console, canary 2 weeks internal + pilot customers?

mike (eng-platform): +1 from platform.

joel (infra): +1 infra. Will add implementation PR and perf tests.

ravi (sre): +1 ops. Will write playbook and alert rules.

sophia (sales): +1 sales, will confirm pilot customer and timelines.

anya (prod): Great — I'll add to roadmap and update the public-facing Dedicated capacity spec. Action items: anya: update roadmap + spec; mike: implementation plan + estimate; joel: infra PR; ravi: ops playbook; sophia: pilot signoff.

capacity-bot: NOTE: action items recorded. Due date preliminary: 6 weeks.

anya (prod): One more thing — pricing impact. We should discuss whether to discount per-fragment idle hold. Flagging for next-week pricing sync.

mike (eng-platform): Ack. I'll prepare a token-cost model for fragment prewarm vs pooled prewarm.

anya (prod): Thanks all. Closing thread unless objections (reply if you see anything missing). :white_check_mark:
